newsitem.title: USA: Birmingham CFO okay with '97 EPS estimate.
newsitem.headline: Birmingham CFO okay with '97 EPS estimate.

text.p: Birmingham Steel Corp's chief financial officer said he is comfortable with Wall Street analysts' consensus earnings estimates of $1.10 a share for the fiscal year ending June 1997.
"We're certainly comfortable with that," said CFO John Casey, in an interview after he addressed the Atlanta Society of Financial Analysts.
The projected positive earnings for the current fiscal year compare with a net loss of $0.08 per share that the minimill company incurred in fiscal 1996.
